Imereti: Caves and Canyons

Three days in western Georgia: Uplistsikhe, Kutaisi, Gelati, Prometheus, Sataplia and Okatse.

days
3 / 2 nights
Total distance
640 km
Total driving
10:30
Car needed
Crossover / SUV
Season
May–October
Difficulty
Moderate

Click a marker for details. Coloured lines are ready-made road trips.

Imereti is the limestone corner of Georgia, and limestone means caves, canyons and waterfalls. Kutaisi, the country's second city, is the perfect base for all of it: nothing on this route is more than an hour's drive from the centre. Three days is the honest minimum, because this density of natural and historical sights simply does not compress into one.

The first stop on the way west is Uplistsikhe, the rock-cut town near Gori where pagan sacrificial halls and Hellenistic chambers survive above the Mtkvari. In Kutaisi you get Bagrati Cathedral on its hill and one of the liveliest markets in the country, and just outside town stand Gelati, the UNESCO-listed academy founded by David the Builder with its great apse mosaic, and tiny Motsameta perched over a river bend. Day two goes underground: the stalactite halls and subterranean river of Prometheus Cave, then Sataplia with its fossilised dinosaur footprints and glass viewing platform. Day three is the Okatse canyon walkway, 700 metres of steel path bolted to the cliff, and the Kinchkha waterfall.

One warning: the approach to Okatse and Kinchkha turns to gravel after Gordi and does not forgive rain, so decent ground clearance genuinely matters here. The season runs May to October — the canyons often close in winter, while the caves stay open all year.

Day-by-day plan

Day 1 · Tbilisi → Uplistsikhe → Kutaisi (245 km, 4 h) - 08:30 Leave Tbilisi on the E60. - 10:00 Uplistsikhe — the cave town and its museum (2 h). - 12:30 Lunch in Gori (1 h). - 16:00 Arrive Kutaisi: Bagrati Cathedral and the Rioni embankment (1 h 30 min). - 19:00 Dinner in the centre; overnight in Kutaisi.

Day 2 · Gelati, Prometheus and Sataplia (90 km, 2 h) - 09:00 Motsameta Monastery on its rock spur (45 min). - 10:15 Gelati Monastery — mosaic, academy, tomb of King David (1 h 30 min). - 13:00 Lunch in Tskaltubo or Kutaisi (1 h). - 14:30 Prometheus Cave, guided walk and the underground boat ride (2 h). - 17:00 Sataplia Reserve: dinosaur footprints and the glass platform (1 h 30 min). - Overnight in Kutaisi.

Day 3 · Okatse, Kinchkha → Tbilisi (305 km, 4 h 30 min) - 08:30 Drive to Gordi; the last 6 km are gravel. - 09:45 Okatse Canyon — the hanging walkway and viewpoint (2 h). - 12:15 Kinchkha waterfall (1 h). - 13:30 Lunch in Gordi or Khoni (1 h). - 15:00 Return via Zestafoni and the Rikoti pass. - 20:00 Back in Tbilisi.

Stops on this route

Cave

Uplistsikhe

A city carved into the rock above the Mtkvari — Georgia's oldest urban centre, with over 3,000 years of history.

2 h
Town

Bagrati Cathedral and central Kutaisi

The cathedral on Ukimerioni hill and the old streets of Kutaisi spread out below it.

3 h
Monastery

Motsameta Monastery

A small monastery on a cliff above the Tskaltsitela gorge, holding the relics of two martyred dukes.

1 h
Monastery

Gelati Monastery

The monastery and academy founded by David the Builder, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

2 h
Nature

Sataplia Nature Reserve

Dinosaur footprints, a karst cave and a glass viewing platform, nine kilometres from Kutaisi.

2 h
Cave

Prometheus Cave

A karst cave near Tskaltubo with lit halls, stone waterfalls and an underground boat ride.

2 h
Canyon

Okatse Canyon

A metal walkway pinned to the canyon wall high above the river, beyond the Gordi forest.

3 h
Waterfall

Kinchkha Waterfall

A cascade waterfall roughly a hundred metres high above Okatse, at the end of a gravel road.

2 h

Tips

  • The final kilometres to Okatse and Kinchkha are gravel — high clearance is needed, doubly so after rain.
  • Prometheus Cave holds 14°C year round: bring a jacket and non-slip shoes.
  • Cave visits run in guided groups with tickets sold on site; midday queues are the longest.
  • Gelati and Motsameta enforce a dress code — headscarf and covered shoulders.
  • Staying in Kutaisi is far cheaper than near the canyons, and everything is 40-60 minutes away.
  • Fill up in Kutaisi — there is no station on the road towards Gordi.
